title: Rezoning to allow taller buildings at 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This application would change the zoning map near 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Flushing, Queens, replacing low-density R2 and R5B districts with an R7A district and adjusting a commercial overlay. The change would allow taller, denser residential and commercial development on the site. It covers property in Queens Community District 7 and Council District 20.
